# YouAses

> YouAses is an independent technology company building artificial intelligence systems, software products, and knowledge platforms for a more intelligent future.

## Company

YouAses combines AI, software engineering, and product design to create technology that helps people understand more, create faster, and move with confidence.

- Website: https://youases.work/
- Company: https://youases.work/company
- Platforms: https://youases.work/platforms
- Journal: https://youases.work/journal
- Contact: mailto:hello@youases.work

## Product

Y-note is a YouAses platform in development. It is being shaped as a connected knowledge environment that helps people move from ideas and information toward context, discovery, and momentum. Product details will be revealed progressively.

## Topics

Artificial intelligence, human-centered AI, software products, knowledge systems, product design, technology research, connected knowledge.
